_comment: Quarkus property metadata registry. buildTime=true means the property is fixed at build/augmentation time.

quarkus.arc.remove-unused-beans.description: If set to true, the build will remove beans not reachable from any injection point.

quarkus.arc.auto-inject-fields.description: If enabled, Arc will attempt to auto-inject fields.

quarkus.datasource.db-kind.description: The kind of database to connect to (e.g. postgresql, mysql).

quarkus.datasource.devservices.enabled.description: Whether to enable DevServices for this datasource.

quarkus.hibernate-orm.database.generatio.description: Select whether the database schema is generated or validated by Hibernate ORM.

quarkus.hibernate-orm.dialect.description: The Hibernate ORM dialect class name.

quarkus.hibernate-orm.physical-naming-st.description: Class name of the physical naming strategy.

quarkus.log.console.enable.description: If console logging should be enabled.

quarkus.log.console.format.description: The format of console log messages.

quarkus.log.file.enable.description: If file logging should be enabled.

quarkus.native.resources.includes.description: Resources to include in native image.

quarkus.native.resources.excludes.description: Resources to exclude from native image.

quarkus.otel.exporter.otlp.enabled.description: Whether the OTLP exporter is enabled.

quarkus.otel.exporter.otlp.endpoint.description: The OTLP endpoint to send traces to.

quarkus.otel.exporter.otlp.headers.description: Key-value pairs to add as headers on every request to the collector.

quarkus.package.compress-jar.description: Whether to compress the resulting jars.

quarkus.package.add-runner-suffix.description: Whether to add the -runner suffix to the produced jar.

quarkus.security.jaxrs.deny-unannotated-.description: Denies access to all JAX-RS resources if no security annotation is declared.

quarkus.smallrye-graphql.schema-availabl.description: Make the schema available over HTTP.

quarkus.swagger-ui.enable.description: Whether Swagger UI should be included in the application.

quarkus.swagger-ui.always-include.description: Whether to always include Swagger UI regardless of the profile.

quarkus.swagger-ui.path.description: The path where Swagger UI is available.

quarkus.vertx.classpath-resolving.description: Whether classpath resources should be resolved.

quarkus.redis.devservices.enabled.description: Whether to enable DevServices for Redis.

quarkus.mongodb.devservices.enabled.description: Whether to enable DevServices for MongoDB.

quarkus.kafka.devservices.enabled.description: Whether to enable DevServices for Kafka.
